description: Na₅Nd₄Si₄O₁₆F crystallizes in the tetragonal I̅4 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.62 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to eight O and two equivalent F atoms. There are four shorter (2.56 Å) and four longer (2.97 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.74 Å. Nd is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to seven O and one F atom. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.60 Å. The Nd-F bond length is 2.60 Å. Si is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.65 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Na, two equivalent Nd, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Nd, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Nd, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Nd, and one Si atom. F is bonded to two equivalent Na and four equivalent Nd atoms to form corner-sharing FNa₂Nd₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
